column1: # seed/tests/r5b/expect.tsv -- extra R5B cases (owner R5B), run by run-r5b.sh. TAB separated: label, file, policy file or -, expectation.
# Expectation: an i64 (the program's `main` value, hand-derived in the comment of each line below) or `E<code> <text>` (the refusal).
# p01: 105 after (rec 5), 115 after (down 4); (inner 7) runs an inner dbl handler (14 -> 34 -> 72 -> 146) and reads the outer 115;
# p02: "q"+"ab"+"ab" = 5 bytes; inner last-only "xyz" = 3 -> 300; outer last-only "k" = 1 -> 10000
# p04: (note "") answers the byte count text "0" (length 1); bump = 1 + 41, then 1 + 42
# the io/write answer is the byte count as text ("3"), whose length is 1
